Package yams.commands3.swerve

package yams.commands3.swerve
Commands v3 swerve drive.

SwerveDrive extends the core SwerveDrive (kinematics, odometry, pose estimation and telemetry) with Command factories that require the Mechanism set in its SwerveDriveConfig. Each wheel is a SwerveModule backed by two SmartMotorControllers (drive and steer), configured with SwerveModuleConfig.

SwerveInputStream turns driver inputs into ChassisVelocities. It holds plain values rather than suppliers: a drive coroutine reads the controller, sets the stick values and modes, and calls get() every loop. 

public class DriveMechanism implements Mechanism {
  private final SwerveDrive drive = new SwerveDrive(
      new SwerveDriveConfig(this, frontLeft, frontRight, backLeft, backRight)
          .withTranslationController(new PIDController(1, 0, 0))
          .withRotationController(new PIDController(1, 0, 0)));

  public Command driveTo(Pose2d pose) {
    return drive.driveToPose(pose, Centimeters.of(5), Degrees.of(3));
  }
}
